integrity: Original source equations compared, all-size derivation reconstructed, exact full-matrix certificate and numerical finite-matrix checks executed. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp capacity and persistence statements are proved for the deterministic fast-exploration, equal-patch, undirected unweighted star model with neighbor-born propagules C(f)=xi*f*A/(1+f), fixed positive patch death/colonization rates and explorer mortality; not a finite-population nonextinction guarantee, not all dispersal networks or arbitrary explorer birth laws. Publication priority remains literature-bounded.
title: A sharp explorer-mortality threshold for reentrant persistence on star habitats
